newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK HEAD SEES NO OVERHEATING PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK HEAD SEES NO OVERHEATING PROBLEMS.

text.p: Estonia's central bank governor Vahur Kraft said on Friday that the bank did not see any problems with the economy overheating after its recent fast growth.
"We don't see any overheating problems in our economy," Kraft told Reuters in an interview.
However he said there was some concern about the loan portfolios of some of the commercial banks.
"We are a little bit concerned about the growth of loan portfolios in the banking sector and especially in the third quarter of 1996.
"But the situation nowadays is that this growth is going down and I think that from our side we have some ideas on how we can manage this process."
He said the Bank of Estonia would look at the loan portfolio and the balance sheets of the commercial banks.
"We have some instruments we can use to control this but we have not finally decided which kind of instrument we will use," Kraft said.
"I think we will make a decision by the middle of this year."
